widgets_values: A drone flies on past the end of its orbit, circling to the left around a tall white kinetic sculpture with mirrored steel spheres on a grassy hill at a science visitor centre on a bright summer day, while a visitor stands beside the curved white wall.

The target video is photoreal aerial footage in the look of a clean documentary drone shot, filmed on a wide lens in strong midday summer sunlight with crisp shadows, saturated greens and a deep blue sky scattered with bright white cumulus clouds. [Shot 1] The camera flies in a smooth, steady arc to the left around a modern kinetic sculpture that stands on the crest of a mown grass hill, at the height of the top of the curved wall and looking slightly down. The sculpture is a tall, slender white painted steel mast braced by three curved white legs that sweep down to a ring of concrete. From the top of the mast a long, thin white arm curves out like a balance beam, carrying a large polished mirror sphere at one end and two smaller mirror spheres at the other, reflecting the sky, the clouds and the green hill. At the foot of the sculpture a round bed of grass sits inside a wide circular plaza of pale, smooth concrete, edged by a low curved concrete bench and by a tall curved white wall that rises like a sail, with dark blue information panels of planets along its inner face. A visitor in a grey jacket, dark trousers and a pink cap stands on the concrete path beside the wall, facing the panels. As the camera circles on past where it began, the curved wall turns until its plain white back faces the camera, the panels slide out of view behind it, and the round plaza and bench open out beside it. Around the plaza the hill is covered in bright green lawn with patches of clover and a few worn sandy spots, and a pale concrete footpath curves away down the slope. Beyond the hill stands a line of full, dark green summer trees, with low white visitor centre buildings, a parking area and a tall white rocket on display on blue supports in the distance. The visitor stays still, the long arm drifts very slowly in the breeze, sunlight glints on the chrome spheres and the clouds drift slowly across the sky.
A light summer breeze over the grass, distant birdsong and the faint hum of a drone.

widgets_values: The camera arcs slowly to the right around the outdoor tables of a small cafe on a cobbled side street in an old European city on a bright autumn morning, where a young woman reads a newspaper and an older man talks on the phone.

The target video is a photoreal, naturally lit street film in the look of a European travel documentary, shot on a 35 mm lens with soft contrast, fine film grain and the cool, even light of a clear morning, the narrow strip of pale sky between the tall buildings bright and slightly hazy. [Shot 1] The camera stands on the grey stone pavement of a narrow cobbled street lined with tall ochre and sandstone buildings of five and six storeys, their tall shuttered windows, iron balconies and carved cornices receding toward a distant crossroads. On the left a small cherry red vintage car with chrome bumpers, round headlights and a cream interior is parked against the kerb, its glossy paint reflecting the street. To the right a cafe with a red and white striped scalloped awning, brass wall lamps and dark wooden window frames sets out round white marble tables and woven rattan bistro chairs on the pavement. Red geraniums spill from window boxes above the tables, and a hand-chalked menu board leans against the wall beside two parked bicycles. A young woman with long brown hair in a mustard yellow raincoat sits at a table reading a folded newspaper, a white espresso cup and saucer in front of her. A small brown dachshund lies on the cobbles at her feet, chin on its paws. At the next table an older man in a grey flat cap, glasses and a navy cardigan holds a phone to his ear, a cup of coffee before him. The camera arcs slowly and smoothly to the right around the cafe tables, keeping them in the middle of the frame, so the car slides out of view on the left, the striped awning and the cafe front turn toward the camera, and more of the far pavement, the doorways and the shop windows further up the street come into view. The woman turns a page of her newspaper, the man nods as he listens and the dachshund lifts its head. Leaves stir faintly in the window boxes and steam curls from the cups.
Quiet street ambience, a cup set down on a saucer, distant footsteps on cobbles and soft city murmur.
